name: Cavitation
description: Vapour bubble formation and collapse where local pressure falls below vapour pressure

name: Dry running / loss of prime
description: Pump runs without the liquid that cools and lubricates it; S-06 describes possible disintegration and a dry-running protection device

name: Air / gas ingress
description: Air or gas entering with the liquid and blocking the impeller inlet

name: Bearing failure
description: Rolling-bearing damage (ISO 15243 failure modes via S-12)

name: Shaft misalignment
description: Pump and motor shaft centrelines not aligned

name: Mechanical seal failure
description: Seal faces or secondary elements no longer sealing

name: Impeller damage
description: Erosion, corrosion or mechanical damage of the impeller

name: Impeller blockage / fouling
description: Debris or deposits obstructing impeller passages

name: Discharge restriction / low-flow operation
description: Pump operating at very low flow or against a closed/restricted discharge

name: Wear-ring wear
hazard_source_locator: KR-1 (no source assigns a hazard class)
cost_downtime_source_locator: Step 1 (no legacy or researched source gives a value)
description: Excessive internal clearance causing internal leakage (S-01 pp.16 and 35)

name: Motor fault
description: Motor overloaded or electrically faulty (legacy F08 and F14 merged; supply imbalance kept as cause CAU-39)

name: Normal
cost_downtime_source_locator: KA-3 section 6 (diagnostic outcome, not a maintenance task)
description: No symptom present and key symptoms known to be absent

name: Unknown - further investigation
cost_downtime_source_locator: KA-3 section 6 (diagnostic outcome, not a maintenance task)
description: Symptoms present but no fault reaches 'likely'
